checks: the review case binds a current ARTICLE full body, exact Task and current W27 dossier/M10/M11/M12
the Article must reference the exact W16 revision, task, M step records and B1/B2/C output versions
dossier fields or pointer-only records cannot substitute for the actual reader draft
each reviewer quotation must occur in the actual initial Article body; substantive inquiries cite exact Claim, Evidence or MethodUse
the Article body must be current, retained and valid UTF-8
the reviewer and authors/producer are separated by identity fields, and the later W15 checker cannot equal the producer
draft-first review cannot simultaneously claim unseen author-self-assessment or prior-review conclusions
defect answer keys are structurally forbidden; a non-draft-first review must state its exposure limitation
reviewer inquiries are fixed before any author response and include type, severity, article locator, quote, concern, required check and exact source references
only a declared author can respond, with one response per inquiry, after the inquiry and fixed case
the final reviewed Article must descend from the initial Article object through its retained version history
the fixed reviewer alone resolves every inquiry; responses cannot edit inquiries or sign the review
PASS cannot leave OPEN/UNVERIFIED inquiries; REVISE needs unresolved work; BLOCK needs an unresolved critical inquiry
supported disagreement can be retained as ACCEPTED_DISPUTE without forcing a new claim or false certainty
the final Review binds the actual revised Article, Task, reviewed scope and exact ReviewCoverage
W15 receives the Review as declared evidence and produces READY for PASS, RETURN for REVISE and BLOCKED for BLOCK
PASS allowed scope must remain within the fixed review scope and the W15 decision checks current exact subject/Review coverage
a newer Article, case or upstream W27 revision cannot inherit the old PASS decision
the output fixes author_self_approved=false, model_self_passed=false, publication_authorized=false and review_capability_certified=false
model review requires a current W19 REVIEW/given-material admission, separate model configuration, all reviewed inputs and a successful W31 OperationReceipt
upstream B1/B2/C and Article versions are rechecked at response and final decision
failed or interrupted review writes remain non-authoritative; completed exact decisions are idempotent
concurrent final decisions converge on one Review and one W15 decision without mutually different outcomes
a synchronized two-writer regression reproduces the independent load/decide window and accepts the existing exact W15 decision instead of creating a self-parent record

q_checks.Q01: PASS: current W31 card, T09.L01-L03/T01.L02, registered implementation and sections 15.2.1-15.2.3/13.7/18 were reviewed
q_checks.Q02: FORMAL_PRECONDITION_PENDING: W27-W30, W19, W15 and earlier packages remain IN_PROGRESS rather than ACCEPTED; only the authorized offline W31 interface scope was exercised
q_checks.Q03: PASS_OFFLINE: actual Article review, independent inquiries, author response, closure, final Review and W15 version-bound decision are implemented
q_checks.Q04: PASS_OFFLINE: 16 W31 tests cover actual body/quotes, self-signing, inquiry source types, response completeness/order, PASS/REVISE/BLOCK, supported dispute, critical block, stale Article/revision, exposure, W19/receipt, idempotency/concurrency and forged self-pass/score fields
q_checks.Q05: PASS_LIMITED_RECOVERY: unresolved critical items BLOCK; unresolved noncritical work RETURNS; accepted disputes and bounded limitations remain explicit; old decisions cannot cover later Article or research versions
q_checks.Q06: PASS_SCOPED_REVIEW: only owned synthetic Article, research components and current-version checks were used; no real independent human review, blind capability test, cross-domain detection study or reader assessment was performed
q_checks.Q07: RECORDED_SCOPE: no real model, supplier/API, paid resource, publication, delivery, deployment or external review service was invoked; no reviewer capability claim beyond this offline interface is made

limits: No real independent human or model review of an actual publication draft was performed
Semantic fact/calculation/translation/teaching accuracy, reviewer judgement quality and whether this specific Article deserves PASS remain for real content review
No blind benchmark, unseen new-case test, cross-domain miss/false-reject estimate or general reviewer capability certification was performed
Identity fields are records, not authenticated people; the implementation enforces differences among declared IDs but cannot prove real-world independence
The W31 tests reuse owned W28/W29/W30 outputs and direct W25-compatible records; upstream provenance checks are not replaced
Model tests use synthetic operation receipts and patched admission/config lookups; no real W19 review model, provider or cost was exercised
Review case, Review and W15 records are separate Archive commits; idempotent retries are covered, but this remains an append-only multi-write workflow rather than one atomic database transaction
W32 actual Article/Edition assembly, W12 user reading, production publication, delivery and stage gates remain pending
Formal prerequisites and G01-G04 remain unaccepted; W31 is IN_PROGRESS, not ACCEPTED
